gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Clean, geometric Conthrax shouts in bold letters that never thicken or thin. Noto Sans Kannada is the gentler voice below, with s curves that open wide at both ends, so a larger heading over modest body text feels right.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kayah-l: Noto Sans Kayah Li keeps its brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, and capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Conthrax, bent like one length of tubing, stays up top as the display voice.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: Noto Sans Kharoshthi leaves its curves unclosed and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Conthrax is best at bold display work; the body font is best at quietly carrying text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer reads with generous openings, like chisel notches in wood, and small letters standing almost capital-sized. Conthrax, with curves and straights sharing a single width, sits above it like machined stock.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki reads openly, its exits wide enough to pass light through and every e given a large, clear eye. And Conthrax, with its pipe-cleaner feel, hands over to it so a long passage goes down easily.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-khudawa: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Noto Sans Khudawadi would feel approachable over many lines, a softer follow-up to Conthrax's rod-stock horizontals and verticals.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kr: Contemporary and clean, Conthrax stamps out even a w with no thick or thin strokes, hard and geometric. Noto Sans KR does the quieter job, with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao pushes its x-height well above the usual, with mouths that stay open on c, e, and a. Conthrax draws a constant-width pen line above it, while Noto Sans Lao keeps the text readable beneath.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-lao-loo: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. And Conthrax, laid out like spaghetti in letters, hands over to it for an easy, modern read.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Conthrax looks drawn with one pen tip, every stroke bold and uniform. Noto Sans Lepcha adds approachable curves with a wide opening and a lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals.
